commands.stdout:
usage: context_setup.py [audit] [--repo PATH] [--format text|json]
       context_setup.py apply --repo PATH [--format text|json]
       context_setup.py sync-setups --source-dir PATH [--check] [--format text|json]

Audit is the read-only default when no subcommand is supplied.
Output formats: text, json. Results go to stdout; diagnostics go to stderr.
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 blocking findings, 2 invalid input, 3 decisions required.

Subcommands:
  audit        Read bundled assets and repository state without writes.
  apply        Write confirmed managed content through an atomic change plan.
  sync-setups  Check or refresh bundled canonical skill setup snapshots.

commands.stdout:
usage: context_setup.py audit [-h] [--repo REPO] [--format {text,json}]
                              [--profile PROFILE] [--show-extra-skills]
                              [--setups-dir SETUPS_DIR]

Audit setup-context-driven managed agent instructions without writes.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO           Repository root. Defaults to cwd.
  --format {text,json}  Result format written to stdout.
  --profile PROFILE     Override the manifest profile for audit.
  --show-extra-skills   Reserved for optional skill cleanup reporting.
  --setups-dir SETUPS_DIR
                        Reserved for explicit canonical setup drift checks.

checks.message: unknown invocation writes argparse diagnostic to stderr
audit help truthfully describes implemented extra-skill report
audit help truthfully describes implemented setup drift check
